Q_EN: How is this different from traditional activity recognition? | Isn't your system just a gesture classifier? | What makes your semantic layer novel compared to action recognition?
Q_ZH: 这与传统的动作识别有何不同？ | 你的系统不就是一个手势分类器吗？ | 相比动作识别，语义层的新颖之处在哪？
A_EN: Activity recognition classifies what you are doing. Our layer describes how effort changes over time. We use three events: Stroke, Coast, and Idle. So it is a temporal grammar. Not a category label.
A_ZH: 活动识别分类你在做什么。我们的层描述努力如何随时间变化。我们用三个事件：发力、滑行、休息。所以它是时间语法。不是类别标签。
Followup_Q_EN: So you are not recognizing activities? | Is this still activity recognition? | Where is the boundary?
Followup_Q_ZH: 所以你不是在做活动识别？ | 这还算活动识别吗？ | 边界在哪？
Followup_A_EN: Correct. Activity recognition is a different task. Our layer describes temporal structure, not activity category. Activity recognition could run on top of our semantic output. | No. Activity recognition classifies what; our layer segments how. They are complementary. | The boundary is the output type. Activity recognition outputs a class label. Our layer outputs a temporal phase.
Followup_A_ZH: 正确的。活动识别是另一项任务。我们的层描述时间结构而非活动类别。活动识别可以运行在我们的语义输出之上。 | 不是。活动识别分类什么；我们的层分割如何。它们是互补的。 | 边界在输出类型上。活动识别输出类别标签。我们的层输出时间相位。
Analogy_EN: MIDI sends note events, not sound. We send phase events, not raw signal.
Analogy_ZH: MIDI 传的是音符事件，不是声音。我们传的是阶段事件，不是原始信号。

Q_EN: Why did you choose Stroke
Q_ZH: Coast
A_EN: and Idle? | Could there be a fourth phase? | What is the physical basis for these specific states?
A_ZH: 为什么选择发力、滑行和休息这三个阶段？ | 会有第四个阶段吗？ | 这三个状态的物理基础是什么？
Followup_Q_EN: They are three states of rhythmic effort. Energy in. Energy out. And rest. We chose this small set on purpose. It captures the repeating structure. And it does not tie to one device.
Followup_Q_ZH: 它们是节奏性用力的三种状态。能量进。能量出。和休息。我们故意选这个最小集合。它捕捉反复出现的结构。而且不绑定到某一个设备。
Followup_A_EN: Could there be a fourth phase? | Why stop at three? | Is this vocabulary fixed?
Followup_A_ZH: 会有第四个阶段吗？ | 为什么停在三个？ | 这个词汇集是固定的吗？
Analogy_EN: Possibly. The vocabulary can be extended if a new interaction requires a distinct semantic state. | Because three is the minimal set that covers the energy cycle: injection, dissipation, and rest. | No. It is a design choice. We use three because they fit rhythmic exertion.
Analogy_ZH: 可能。如果新的交互需要不同的语义状态，词汇集可以扩展。 | 因为三个是覆盖能量循环的最小集合：注入、耗散和休息。 | 不是。这是一个设计选择。我们用三个因为它们契合节奏性用力。
Audio_Q: Like MIDI note-on, note-off, and silence. Three events cover the full cycle.
Audio_A: 就像 MIDI 的按下、松开、静默。三个事件就能覆盖整个周期。

Q_EN: How does Row-to-Flow differ from commercial platforms like Zwift? | What is the advantage over existing smart rowers? | Why not map sensors directly to the game?
Q_ZH: Row-to-Flow 与 Zwift 等商业平台有何不同？ | 相比现有智能划船机有什么优势？ | 为什么不直接把传感器映射到游戏里？
A_EN: Most platforms tie the sensor directly to the visuals. We insert a semantic layer in the middle. The sensor produces events. The renderer reads those events. The two sides work independently.
A_ZH: 大多数平台把传感器直接绑到视觉。我们在中间插入一个语义层。传感器产生事件。渲染器读这些事件。两端独立工作。
Followup_Q_EN: So what is the practical advantage? | Does this actually help developers? | Is this just abstraction?
Followup_Q_ZH: 实际优势是什么？ | 这对开发者真有帮助吗？ | 这只是抽象吗？
Followup_A_EN: The advantage is reuse. Once a device produces semantic events, any renderer can consume them without rewriting sensing logic. | Potentially. It separates sensing from rendering, so teams can work independently. | It is abstraction with a purpose: to enable reuse across devices and renderers.
Followup_A_ZH: 优势在于复用。一旦设备产生语义事件，任何渲染器都能消费它们，无需重写传感逻辑。 | 可能有帮助。它把传感和渲染分离，让团队可以独立工作。 | 这是有目的的抽象：为了实现跨设备和渲染器的复用。
Analogy_EN: Zwift is a proprietary cable. We are MIDI: any keyboard, any sound module.
Analogy_ZH: Zwift 像专用线缆。我们像 MIDI：任何键盘，任何音源。

Q_EN: Why use a fixed FSM for rendering but an adaptive one for evaluation? | Isn't the dual-track algorithm inconsistent? | Why not use the adaptive FSM for real-time?
Q_ZH: 为什么渲染用固定 FSM，评估却用自适应算法？ | 双轨算法难道不是前后矛盾吗？ | 为什么不把自适应 FSM 用在实时渲染上？
A_EN: We use two separate tracks on purpose. The real-time track is a fixed FSM. It is light and predictable. The offline track is an adaptive tracker. It studies how energy is lost. Neither depends on the other.
A_ZH: 我们故意用两条独立的轨。实时轨是固定 FSM。它轻量且可预测。离线轨是自适应追踪器。它研究能量如何耗散。两者互不依赖。
Followup_Q_EN: Why not use the adaptive tracker in real time? | Isn't dual-track overkill? | Which one is the system?
Followup_Q_ZH: 为什么不把自适应追踪器用在实时？ | 双轨不是过度设计吗？ | 哪个才是系统？
Followup_A_EN: Because the adaptive tracker is heavier and less predictable. Real-time rendering needs deterministic and low-latency behavior. | We do not think so. The two paths have different requirements. Merging them would either slow down rendering or weaken analysis. | The real-time FSM drives the interaction. The adaptive tracker supports offline analysis. They serve different purposes.
Followup_A_ZH: 因为自适应追踪器更重且不太可预测。实时渲染需要确定且低延迟的行为。 | 我们不这么认为。两条路径有不同的需求。合并它们要么拖慢渲染，要么削弱分析。 | 实时 FSM 驱动交互。自适应追踪器支持离线分析。它们服务于不同目的。
Analogy_EN: Like live MIDI for performance and high-resolution MIDI for recording.
Analogy_ZH: 就像现场 MIDI 用于演出，高分辨率 MIDI 用于录音。

Q_EN: Doesn't the 400ms cooldown create interaction latency? | How do you handle fast strokes with a fixed cooldown? | Will users feel delayed feedback due to the timer?
Q_ZH: 400ms 的固定冷却不会产生交互延迟吗？ | 你怎么用固定冷却处理快速的划船动作？ | 定时器会让用户感觉到反馈延迟吗？
A_EN: We set the 400 millisecond cooldown by hand. We tuned it during pilot testing. It stops small vibrations from firing again. One real stroke should not trigger twice.
A_ZH: 我们手工设了 400 毫秒冷却。在先导测试中调校。它阻止小振动再次触发。一次真正的发力不该触发两次。
Followup_Q_EN: Did you formally benchmark latency? | How do you know it doesn't feel laggy? | What about 300ms?
Followup_Q_ZH: 你们做正式延迟基准了吗？ | 你怎么知道不卡？ | 300ms 怎么样？
Followup_A_EN: No formal benchmark was performed. That is future work. We rely on qualitative observation rather than measured latency. | We relied on participant feedback, not instrumented measurement. That is a limitation. | We did not compare cooldown values systematically. 400 ms was chosen empirically during pilot testing.
Followup_A_ZH: 没有做正式基准测试。那是未来工作。我们依赖定性观察而非测量延迟。 | 我们依赖参与者反馈，而非仪器测量。这是局限。 | 我们没有系统比较冷却值。400ms 是先导测试中经验性选定的。

Q_EN: How does the system handle machine wobbling or slow rowing? | Does gravity tilt affect your IMU readings? | How do you cancel out low-frequency noise?
Q_ZH: 系统如何处理机器晃动或缓慢划船？ | 重力倾斜会影响 IMU 读数吗？ | 你们如何消除低频噪音干扰？
A_EN: We use a 1.5 second rolling median baseline. It removes slow drift. And small changes in gravity. This stops small noise from firing a Stroke.
A_ZH: 我们用 1.5 秒滚动中位数基线。它去除慢漂移。也去除重力的微小变化。这阻止小噪声触发发力。
Followup_Q_EN: Does this completely solve orientation changes? | What if the sensor rotates 90 degrees? | Is the baseline adaptive?
Followup_Q_ZH: 这完全解决方向变化了吗？ | 如果传感器转 90 度呢？ | 基线是自适应的吗？
Followup_A_EN: No. The rolling median suppresses slow drift, but it assumes relatively stable orientation. Large rotations would need explicit orientation compensation. | The signal would change significantly. We would need recalibration or orientation estimation. | The baseline updates continuously, but the FSM thresholds are fixed. That is a partial adaptation, not full adaptivity.
Followup_A_ZH: 不能。滚动中位数抑制慢漂移，但假设方向相对稳定。大幅旋转需要显式方向补偿。 | 信号会显著变化。我们需要重新校准或方向估计。 | 基线持续更新，但 FSM 阈值是固定的。那是部分自适应，不是完全自适应。

Q_EN: Why use find_peaks for CV calculation instead of your FSM? | Isn't it unfair to compare using a different algorithm? | How did you calculate the cycle intervals objectively?
Q_ZH: 为什么用 find_peaks 计算 CV 而不是你们的 FSM？ | 用不同的算法比较不是不公平吗？ | 你是如何客观计算周期间隔的？
A_EN: We did not want to judge the FSM with itself. That would be method bias. So we used an independent detector. It is scipy's find_peaks. It finds cycle peaks in both conditions. We compute CV from those peaks.
A_ZH: 我们不想用 FSM 自己评自己。那会是方法偏倚。所以我们用了独立检测器。它是 scipy 的 find_peaks。它在两种条件里找周期峰值。我们从这些峰值算 CV。
Followup_Q_EN: Why is that fair? | Why not use your own FSM? | Doesn't find_peaks have its own bias?
Followup_Q_ZH: 这公平吗？ | 为什么不用你自己的 FSM？ | find_peaks 没有自己的偏差吗？
Followup_A_EN: Because both conditions are measured with the same independent detector. Neither condition gets an advantage from using its own segmentation. | Because using the FSM to evaluate itself would introduce method bias. Independent measurement is the safer choice. | Every detector has assumptions. What matters is that the same detector is applied to both conditions, so relative comparison is fair.
Followup_A_ZH: 因为两种条件都用同一个独立检测器测量。没有条件会因为使用自己的分割而获得优势。 | 因为用 FSM 评估自己会引入方法偏差。独立测量是更安全的选择。 | 每个检测器都有假设。重要的是同一个检测器应用于两种条件，所以相对比较是公平的。

Q_EN: How exactly does the adaptive energy-informed tracker work? | How do you calculate the coast duration offline? | What does t_coast proportional to effort mean?
Q_ZH: 自适应能量追踪器具体是如何工作的？ | 你们离线如何计算滑行时间？ | 滑行时间与发力成正比是什么意思？
A_EN: Offline, we look at the effort curve during a Stroke. We use its area as an effort proxy. A larger area indicates more effort. We use that to extend the Coast. More effort, longer coast.
A_ZH: 离线时，我们看发力期间的用力曲线。我们用它的面积作为努力程度的代理量。面积越大表示努力程度越高。我们用这个来延长滑行。努力越大，滑行越长。
Followup_Q_EN: Does that exactly model physical momentum? | Is this just an approximation? | Why this formula?
Followup_Q_ZH: 这精确模拟物理动量了吗？ | 这只是近似吗？ | 为什么用这个公式？
Followup_A_EN: No. It is a physics-informed approximation, not a direct momentum measurement. It captures the qualitative relationship between effort and coast duration. | Yes, an intentional one. We are not modeling mechanics precisely; we are estimating a semantic duration that scales with effort. | Because it is simple and matches the qualitative relationship: more effort, longer coast.
Followup_A_ZH: 不是。这是基于物理的近似，不是直接的动量测量。它捕捉努力与滑行时长之间的定性关系。 | 是的，是有意为之的近似。我们不精确建模力学；我们估计的是随努力变化的语义时长。 | 因为它简单且符合定性关系：努力越大，滑行越长。

Q_EN: Why was P02 excluded from the paired t-test but kept in the figures? | Was P02's data deleted? | Why not remove P02 entirely from the paper?
Q_ZH: 为什么 P02 被排除在配对 t 检验外，但保留在图中？ | P02 的数据被删了吗？ | 为什么不彻底删掉 P02？
A_EN: P02 is out of the paired CV test. One condition had fewer than three valid cycles. That is our predefined rule. We did not delete the data. It is still in the figures for transparency.
A_ZH: P02 被排除在配对 CV 检验外。一个条件下有效周期少于三个。这是我们的预定义规则。我们没有删除数据。它仍在图中以保持透明。
Followup_Q_EN: Was this decided after seeing the results? | Could exclusion affect the result? | Why keep P02 in the figures?
Followup_Q_ZH: 这是看了结果才决定的吗？ | 排除会影响结果吗？ | 为什么把 P02 留在图中？
Followup_A_EN: No. The criterion was defined as a data-quality rule based on interval count. It did not depend on the statistical outcome. | Yes, exclusion can affect a small-sample analysis. That is one reason we describe the result as exploratory. | To preserve transparency. We kept the raw data visible so reviewers can see exactly what was excluded and why.
Followup_A_ZH: 不是。标准被定义为基于间隔计数的数据质量规则。它不依赖统计结果。 | 会，排除会影响小样本分析。这也是我们把结果描述为探索性的原因之一。 | 为了保持透明。我们保留原始数据可见，让评审者能看到到底排除了什么以及为什么。
Analogy_EN: Like a bad MIDI take that you still keep in the session file, but don't mix into the final track.
Analogy_ZH: 就像一个录坏的 MIDI 片段，你保留在工程文件里，但不混进最终成品。

Keywords: ESP32 | low-cost IMU | strap on anything
Q_EN: Is the hardware required for this semantic layer expensive? | Can I attach this to my home rower? | What is the material cost of your sensing module?
Q_ZH: 实现这个语义层所需的硬件昂贵吗？ | 我能把它装在我家里的划船机上吗？ | 你们传感模块的物料成本是多少？
A_EN: The hardware is cheap. We use an ESP32 board. And a low-cost IMU. It straps onto existing gear. No special rowing machine is needed.
A_ZH: 硬件很便宜。我们用 ESP32 板。和一个低成本 IMU。它绑在现有设备上。不需要专门的划船机。
Followup_Q_EN: Is the exact hardware part of the contribution? | Why ESP32? | Could you use a phone IMU? | What IMU did you use?
Followup_Q_ZH: 硬件本身是贡献的一部分吗？ | 为什么用 ESP32？ | 能用手机 IMU 吗？ | 你用了什么 IMU？
Followup_A_EN: No. The hardware is an implementation vehicle. The contribution is the semantic layer and the protocol. | It is low-cost, widely available, and has built-in wireless. Good for a prototype, not part of the contribution. | Potentially yes. Any IMU that produces comparable acceleration data could work. | We used a JY901S. It is a 9-axis module. We only used the accelerometer channel at 50 Hz. If the paper says MPU6050, that is a typo. The actual IMU is JY901S. It does not affect the data or method.
Followup_A_ZH: 不是。硬件是实现载体。贡献是语义层和协议。 | 它低成本、广泛可用、带无线。适合做原型，不是贡献的一部分。 | 可能可以。任何能产生可比加速度数据的 IMU 都可能工作。 | 我们用了 JY901S。它是 9 轴模块。我们只用了加速度通道，50 Hz。如果论文写 MPU6050，那是笔误。实际 IMU 是 JY901S。不影响数据或方法。

Q_EN: Is a sample size of 11 enough to draw valid conclusions? | Why didn't you recruit more participants? | Does the small N limit your claims?
Q_ZH: 11 人的样本量足以得出有效结论吗？ | 为什么不招募更多参与者？ | 小样本量会限制你们的主张吗？
A_EN: This is an exploratory short paper. The goal is to identify a pattern. Not to confirm one. N is 11. So we read the results cautiously. They motivate a larger study.
A_ZH: 这是一篇探索性短文。目标是识别模式。不是确认模式。N 是 11。所以我们谨慎解读结果。它们为更大研究提供动机。
Followup_Q_EN: So you cannot claim the semantic layer improves performance? | Why publish with N=11? | Is this statistically meaningful?
Followup_Q_ZH: 所以你不能声称语义层提升性能？ | 为什么用 N=11 发表？ | 这有统计意义吗？
Followup_A_EN: Correct. We do not make a confirmatory improvement claim. We observed a pattern worth testing in a larger study. | Because it is an exploratory short paper. The goal is hypothesis generation, not confirmation. | The p-value did not cross 0.05. The effect size suggests a moderate pattern. We treat this as exploratory.
Followup_A_ZH: 正确。我们不做确认性的提升声明。我们观察到值得在更大研究中检验的模式。 | 因为这是探索性短文。目标是生成假设，不是确认。 | p 值没有跨过 0.05。效应量提示中等模式。我们将其视为探索性。

Q_EN: Did you manually remove outliers to get better results? | How was the exclusion criterion decided? | Was this decided after seeing the results?
Q_ZH: 你们是为了结果好看手动删了异常值吗？ | 排除标准是怎么定的？ | 这是看了结果才决定的吗？
A_EN: No. P02 was not removed by hand. The rule was set before we looked at the data. It is based on cycle count. The raw data is still there. And still shown in the figures.
A_ZH: 不是。P02 不是手动删除的。规则在查看数据前就定了。它基于周期计数。原始数据还在。仍显示在图中。
Followup_Q_EN: Could this affect the result? | Was P02 an outlier? | Did you lose power?
Followup_Q_ZH: 这会影响结果吗？ | P02 是异常值吗？ | 损失了统计力吗？
Followup_A_EN: Yes, small-sample exclusion can affect results. We describe it transparently and treat the outcome as exploratory. | Not in the manual sense. P02 was excluded by a predefined data-quality rule, not by looking at the outcome. | Yes, exclusion reduces effective sample size. With N=11 already small, this makes the study more exploratory.
Followup_A_ZH: 会，小样本排除会影响结果。我们透明描述并把它视为探索性。 | 不是手动意义上的。P02 被预定义的数据质量规则排除，不是通过看结果。 | 会，排除减少有效样本量。N=11 本就小，这使研究更具探索性。

Q_EN: Did the order of conditions affect the user preference? | How did you handle learning effects during the 3-minute trials? | Was the study counterbalanced?
Q_ZH: 条件顺序是否影响了用户偏好？ | 你们怎么处理 3 分钟测试里的学习效应？ | 实验有做平衡序处理吗？
A_EN: We counterbalanced the order across participants. Each person also got 30 seconds to warm up. Then the 3 minute trial started. This reduces learning effects.
A_ZH: 我们在被试间平衡了顺序。每人还有 30 秒热身。然后 3 分钟试验开始。这减少学习效应。
Followup_Q_EN: Can you completely eliminate learning effects? | Is 30 seconds enough? | Why not longer?
Followup_Q_ZH: 你能完全消除学习效应吗？ | 30 秒够吗？ | 为什么不更长？
Followup_A_EN: No. Counterbalancing reduces systematic order effects, but it cannot prove all learning disappeared. | Enough for basic familiarization with the motion and interface. It is not enough for full motor learning. | Because we had a strict time budget per participant. A longer familiarization would extend the session.
Followup_A_ZH: 不能。平衡减少系统性顺序效应，但不能证明所有学习消失。 | 足以对动作和界面基本熟悉。不足以完成完整运动学习。 | 因为每位参与者有严格时间预算。更长熟悉期会延长会话。

Q_EN: Your p-value is 0.144. Why is it still meaningful? | How do you justify conclusions with p > 0.05? | What does the Cohen's d of 0.506 mean here?
Q_ZH: p 值是 0.144，为什么还有意义？ | p>0.05 怎么支撑结论？ | 这里的 Cohen's d 0.506 意味着什么？
A_EN: The paired test gave p equals 0.144. That is not significant. The confidence interval includes zero. But Cohen's d is 0.506. That is consistent with a medium effect size. It suggests a pattern worth testing. We do not treat it as confirmatory.
A_ZH: 配对检验给出 p 等于 0.144。这不显著。置信区间包含零。但 Cohen's d 是 0.506。这与中等效应量一致。它提示值得检验的模式。我们不把它当作确认性证据。
Followup_Q_EN: So your result is basically insignificant? | Why mention the effect size? | What should we conclude?
Followup_Q_ZH: 所以你的结果基本不显著？ | 为什么提效应量？ | 我们应该得出什么结论？
Followup_A_EN: Statistically insignificant, yes. But statistical significance and effect magnitude are different. We report both. | Because it gives us a signal about the magnitude, independent of sample size. | That there is a pattern worth testing, not a confirmed effect.
Followup_A_ZH: 统计上不显著，是的。但统计显著性和效应幅度是不同的。我们两者都报告。 | 因为它给了我们独立于样本量的幅度信号。 | 有一个值得检验的模式，不是已确认的效应。

Keywords: higher CV | timing variability | independent measurement
Q_EN: Doesn't a higher CV mean the semantic layer worsened their motor control? | Why is a higher cycle variation a good thing? | Did the users row worse in your system?
Q_ZH: CV 变高不就意味着语义层让运动控制变差了吗？ | 为什么周期变异度变高是好事？ | 用户在系统里划得更差了吗？
A_EN: Not necessarily. Higher CV means more variation in timing. It does not mean worse control. We treat it as greater timing variability. We do not call it better performance. The CV came from an independent detector.
A_ZH: 不一定。更高的 CV 意味着时序变化更大。它不等于控制更差。我们把它视为更大的时序变异。我们不把它称为更好的表现。CV 来自独立检测器。
Followup_Q_EN: Could higher CV actually mean worse performance? | Is this just noise? | Why is variation good?
Followup_Q_ZH: 更高的 CV 实际上可能意味着更差的表现吗？ | 这只是噪声吗？ | 为什么变化是好事？
Followup_A_EN: Yes, that is a possible interpretation. Higher CV could indicate more variability. We do not claim it is inherently better. | Not necessarily. The measurement is independent of the FSM, so the variation reflects actual cycle timing. | We do not claim that it is good. We interpret it as a possible sign of more flexible pacing.
Followup_A_ZH: 是的，那是一种可能的解释。更高的 CV 可能表明更大的变异性。我们不声称它本质上更好。 | 不一定。测量独立于 FSM，所以变化反映实际周期时序。 | 我们不声称它是好事。我们将其解释为可能更灵活配速的信号。

Q_EN: Why was overall subjective preference mixed? | Why did 4 people prefer the baseline? | Is your visual design flawed?
Q_ZH: 为什么整体主观偏好是混合的？ | 为什么有 4 个人更喜欢基线？ | 你们的视觉设计有缺陷吗？
A_EN: This suggests two things are separate. Semantic clarity. And visual style. People liked the clearer phases. But their visual taste was mixed. We do not claim one look fits everyone.
A_ZH: 这表明两件事是分开的。语义清晰度。和视觉风格。人们喜欢更清晰的阶段。但他们的视觉口味是混合的。我们不声称一种外观适合所有人。
Followup_Q_EN: So your visual design was not universally preferred? | Why did 4 prefer baseline? | Is aesthetics a separate issue?
Followup_Q_ZH: 所以你的视觉设计不是普遍被偏好的？ | 为什么 4 人偏好基线？ | 美学是独立问题吗？
Followup_A_EN: Correct. We do not claim universal aesthetic preference. Some participants preferred the baseline visuals. | Possibly because of visual style preferences. We did not systematically code the reasons. | Yes. Semantic clarity and visual aesthetics appear to be separate design dimensions.
Followup_A_ZH: 正确。我们不声称普遍审美偏好。一些参与者偏好基线视觉。 | 可能是因为视觉风格偏好。我们没有系统编码原因。 | 是的。语义清晰度和视觉美学似乎是独立的设计维度。

Q_EN: What specific aspect of the semantic layer did users prefer? | How did users describe the semantic experience? | Why did users favor stage clarity?
Q_ZH: 用户到底更喜欢语义层的哪个具体方面？ | 用户如何描述语义体验的？ | 为什么用户偏好阶段清晰度？
A_EN: The clearest preference was stage clarity. People used time words. Pull. Glide. Return. Not just force words. So the phase structure was easy to feel.
A_ZH: 最清晰的偏好是阶段清晰度。人们用时间词。拉。滑。回。不只是力量词。所以阶段结构容易被感知。
Followup_Q_EN: Does that prove semantic internalization? | Is this just suggestion? | How did you code the responses?
Followup_Q_ZH: 这证明语义内化了吗？ | 这只是暗示吗？ | 你怎么编码回答的？
Followup_A_EN: No. It provides qualitative evidence that participants described the experience in phase-like terms. That is suggestive, not proof. | It is qualitative evidence, not a controlled measure. We present it as supportive, not confirmatory. | We analyzed open-ended responses for temporal terms like pull, glide, return. This was done qualitatively.
Followup_A_ZH: 不能。它提供参与者用类似阶段术语描述的定性证据。那是提示性的，不是证明。 | 它是定性证据，不是受控测量。我们将其作为支持性而非确认性证据呈现。 | 我们分析开放式回答中的时间术语，如拉、滑、回。这是定性完成的。

Q_EN: Does the respiratory trainer actually prove cross-device interoperability? | Why use a breathing trainer? | Isn't one extra device too weak for a claim?
Q_ZH: 呼吸训练器真的能证明跨设备的互操作性吗？ | 为什么用呼吸训练器？ | 仅仅多一个设备不足以证明通用性吧？
A_EN: No. It is a proof of concept. Not formal validation. The breathing trainer works very differently. About 4 times smaller amplitude. But the same three-state vocabulary was applicable.
A_ZH: 不能。这是一个概念验证。不是正式验证。呼吸训练器工作方式很不同。振幅大约小四倍。但同样的三状态词汇仍然适用。
Followup_Q_EN: So what does it actually show? | Is one extra device enough? | What would prove interoperability?
Followup_Q_ZH: 那它到底说明了什么？ | 一个额外设备够吗？ | 什么才能证明互操作性？
Followup_A_EN: It shows that the semantic vocabulary is not obviously tied to the physical scale of the rowing motion. | Not for full interoperability validation. It provides initial feasibility evidence. | Systematic testing across multiple devices, sensing modalities, and physical scales.
Followup_A_ZH: 它表明语义词汇集没有明显绑定到划船运动的物理尺度上。 | 不足以做完整互操作性验证。它提供初步可行性证据。 | 跨多个设备、传感模态和物理尺度的系统性测试。
Analogy_EN: Like a MIDI drum machine plugged into the same protocol.
Analogy_ZH: 就像一台 MIDI 鼓机插入了同一个协议。

Q_EN: How did you map continuous breathing into discrete strokes? | What does the custom pneumatic piston do? | Why are the respiratory signals so sharp?
Q_ZH: 你是如何把连续呼吸映射成离散发力的？ | 定制气动活塞起什么作用？ | 为什么呼吸信号看起来这么尖锐？
A_EN: The custom piston turns airflow into mechanical hits. Back and forth. The hits are repeatable. So we get a signal. We can run the same pipeline as rowing. Same semantic extraction.
A_ZH: 定制活塞把气流变成机械撞击。来回往复。撞击是可重复的。所以我们得到一个信号。我们能跑和划船相同的流程。相同的语义提取。
Followup_Q_EN: Is this the same physical phenomenon as rowing? | Why a piston? | Could this work for speech?
Followup_Q_ZH: 这和划船是同一物理现象吗？ | 为什么用活塞？ | 这能用于语音吗？
Followup_A_EN: No. The mechanics are different. The point is that the semantic decomposition can be applied to both. | Because it mechanically rectifies bidirectional airflow into repeatable impacts. | Not with this prototype. Speech has different temporal structure.
Followup_A_ZH: 不是。力学机制不同。关键在于语义分解可以应用于两者。 | 因为它机械地将双向气流整流为可重复的撞击。 | 这个原型不行。语音有不同的时间结构。

Keywords: independent peak detector | no mocap | future benchmark
Q_EN: Where is the ground truth or formal latency estimate? | Why didn't you use motion capture cameras? | How accurate is the FSM without ground truth?
Q_ZH: ground truth 或延迟估计在哪里？ | 为什么不用动捕相机？ | 没有真值，FSM 准确度如何？
A_EN: We did not use motion capture in this study. So we have no motion-capture ground truth. We used an independent offline peak detector. That gave us cycle-level measurements. Mocap benchmarking is future work. So is direct latency measurement.
A_ZH: 我们这项研究没有使用动作捕捉。所以没有基于动捕的 ground truth。我们使用了独立的离线峰值检测器。它提供了周期级测量。动捕基准测试是未来工作。直接延迟测量也是。
Followup_Q_EN: So you don't know the absolute accuracy of the FSM? | Why no mocap? | How can we trust the labels?
Followup_Q_ZH: 所以你不知道 FSM 的绝对准确度？ | 为什么不用动捕？ | 我们怎么相信标签？
Followup_A_EN: Correct. We have not established absolute detection accuracy against ground truth. | Because this is an exploratory short paper, and motion capture was not available in our setup. | You cannot verify them against ground truth from this study. You can verify that the CV measurement is independent of the FSM.
Followup_A_ZH: 正确。我们还没有针对真实基准建立绝对检测精度。 | 因为这是探索性短文，动捕在我们的设置中不可用。 | 你无法从这项研究中对真实基准验证它们。你可以验证 CV 测量独立于 FSM。

Q_EN: How exactly did the baseline condition map the sensor data? | Did the baseline have any filtering? | Why did you use an inertia term in the baseline?
Q_ZH: 基线条件到底是如何映射传感器数据的？ | 基线有加滤波吗？ | 为什么基线里要加惯性项？
A_EN: The baseline used continuous signal processing. A low pass filter. And a direct force to speed mapping. With an inertia term. It did not segment the interaction. No discrete phases.
A_ZH: 基线使用连续信号处理。一个低通滤波器。和力到速度的直接映射。带惯性项。它没有分割交互。没有离散阶段。
Followup_Q_EN: Why did you choose that baseline? | Is the baseline fair? | Did the baseline have any semantic structure?
Followup_Q_ZH: 为什么选这个基线？ | 基线公平吗？ | 基线有任何语义结构吗？
Followup_A_EN: We wanted a continuous-mapping condition that represents conventional signal-to-visual coupling. | We designed it to represent current commercial practice. It is not adversarially weak. | No. That is the point. The baseline maps raw signal directly to visuals without semantic segmentation.
Followup_A_ZH: 我们想要一个代表传统信号到视觉耦合的连续映射条件。 | 我们设计它来代表当前商业实践。它不是对抗性弱化的。 | 没有。这正是关键。基线把原始信号直接映射到视觉，没有语义分割。

Q_EN: Your paper lacks some experimental and demographic details. Why? | Where can I find the questionnaire items? | Are the scripts available?
Q_ZH: 你的论文缺乏实验和人口统计细节，为什么？ | 我在哪能找到问卷题目？ | 脚本公开了吗？
A_EN: The paper had a strict 4 page limit. So we kept the core content in the paper. Supporting materials are in the OSF supplement. Demographics. Ethics. Questionnaires. Raw data. Figures. Analysis scripts.
A_ZH: 论文有严格的 4 页限制。所以核心内容留在论文。支持材料在 OSF 补充材料。人口统计。伦理。问卷。原始数据。图表。分析脚本。
Followup_Q_EN: Can the analysis be reproduced? | Where is the raw data? | Are the videos available?
Followup_Q_ZH: 分析能复现吗？ | 原始数据在哪？ | 视频有吗？
Followup_A_EN: The analysis scripts and data needed to inspect the reported results are in the supplement. | In the anonymized OSF repository. Participant-level data, questionnaires, and analysis scripts are all there. | Supplementary video is available. Full video logs are not included for privacy reasons.
Followup_A_ZH: 检查所报告结果所需的分析脚本和数据在补充材料中。 | 在匿名 OSF 仓库中。参与者级数据、问卷和分析脚本都在那里。 | 补充视频可用。完整视频日志因隐私原因未包含。

Q_EN: Why did you choose particles and trails for visual feedback? | How does the visual layer respond to the phases? | Are the visuals hardcoded?
Q_ZH: 为什么选粒子和轨迹作为视觉反馈？ | 视觉层如何响应语义阶段？ | 视觉效果是写死在代码里的吗？
A_EN: The visuals are a separate design layer. The renderer reads the semantic event stream. Stroke can fire particles. Coast can leave a trail. Idle goes back to calm motion.
A_ZH: 视觉是一个独立的设计层。渲染器读语义事件流。发力可以触发粒子。滑行留下轨迹。休息回到平静运动。
Followup_Q_EN: Are the visuals hardcoded? | Could you use a different renderer? | Is this aesthetic or functional?
Followup_Q_ZH: 视觉是写死的吗？ | 能用别的渲染器吗？ | 这是美学还是功能？
Followup_A_EN: The visual mapping is designed, not learned. But it consumes semantic events rather than raw sensor values. | Yes. Because the renderer subscribes to semantic events, a different renderer could consume the same events. | Both. The visual layer is a design dimension. The mapping is functional, but the style is aesthetic.
Followup_A_ZH: 视觉映射是设计的，不是学习的。但它消费语义事件而非原始传感器值。 | 可以。因为渲染器订阅语义事件，不同的渲染器可以消费相同的事件。 | 都是。视觉层是一个设计维度。映射是功能性的，但风格是美学的。
Analogy_EN: Like a MIDI synthesizer responding to note events, not to the keyboard brand.
Analogy_ZH: 就像 MIDI 合成器响应音符事件，而不是响应键盘品牌。

Q_EN: Can this exact handle-mounted IMU approach be used for cycling or weightlifting? | Will it work for non-rhythmic sports? | What limits your approach?
Q_ZH: 这套手柄 IMU 方法能直接用于骑行或举重吗？ | 它能用于非节律性运动吗？ | 你们方法的局限在哪？
A_EN: Not with the exact same setup. The semantic grammar may transfer. But cycling may need a crank sensor. Weightlifting may need a different sensor. The sensor changes. The semantic vocabulary can stay the same.
A_ZH: 不一定用完全相同的设置。语义语法可能迁移。但骑行可能需要曲柄传感器。举重可能需要不同的传感器。传感器变。语义词汇集可以保持一致。
Followup_Q_EN: So what is device-agnostic? | What stays the same across devices? | What changes?
Followup_Q_ZH: 那什么是设备无关的？ | 跨设备什么保持不变？ | 什么会变？
Followup_A_EN: The semantic interface is device-agnostic. Sensing hardware can vary. The output vocabulary stays the same. | The three-phase vocabulary and the event-based output format. What changes is the sensor modality. | The sensor type and mounting. Rowing uses a handle IMU; cycling might need a crank sensor.
Followup_A_ZH: 语义接口是设备无关的。传感硬件可以变化。输出词汇集保持不变。 | 三阶段词汇集和基于事件的输出格式。变化的是传感模态。 | 传感器类型和安装方式。划船用手柄 IMU；骑行可能需要曲柄传感器。

Keywords: rectified effort | recoil | no new Stroke
Q_EN: How does your system handle the return motion or negative acceleration? | Does pushing the handle back trigger a stroke? | What happens when the handle retracts?
Q_ZH: 系统如何处理回桨动作或负加速度？ | 把手推回去会触发发力吗？ | 把手缩回时会怎样？
A_EN: We use rectified effort. We only care about magnitude. So the return motion does not fire a new event. It just falls into Coast or Idle.
A_ZH: 我们用整流后的努力。我们只关心幅度。所以回程不会触发新事件。它自然落入滑行或休息。
Followup_Q_EN: Why rectify it? | Doesn't that lose information? | What about pull direction?
Followup_Q_ZH: 为什么整流？ | 那不是丢失信息了吗？ | 拉的方向呢？
Followup_A_EN: Because we are interested in the effort envelope, not the direction. | It loses direction, but that is intentional. We only need to know that effort is present. | Direction is not part of the semantic phase. The phase describes energy state, not physical direction.
Followup_A_ZH: 因为我们感兴趣的是努力包络，不是方向。 | 它丢失方向，但那是有意的。我们只需要知道努力存在。 | 方向不是语义阶段的一部分。阶段描述能量状态，不是物理方向。

Q_EN: Was there any injury risk during the rowing trials? | Did you get ethical approval? | How did you ensure participant safety?
Q_ZH: 划船试验有受伤风险吗？ | 你们有伦理审批吗？ | 如何保证参与者安全？
A_EN: We told people to use a comfortable pace. Not maximum effort. Everyone signed informed consent. The ethics details are in the OSF supplement.
A_ZH: 我们告诉人们用舒适的配速。不是最大努力。每个人都签了知情同意。伦理细节在 OSF 补充材料中。
Followup_Q_EN: Did anyone have to push to exhaustion? | Was this really max effort? | What was the target intensity?
Followup_Q_ZH: 有人要力竭吗？ | 这真的是最大努力吗？ | 目标强度是什么？
Followup_A_EN: No. The protocol was self-paced. | No. We do not describe it as max effort. It was a self-paced trial. | There was no fixed target. Participants were instructed to use a comfortable, self-selected pace.
Followup_A_ZH: 没有。方案是自选配速。 | 没有。我们不把它描述为最大努力。它是自选配速试验。 | 没有固定目标。参与者被指示使用舒适、自选的配速。

Q_EN: What role did the whoosh sound play in your experiment? | Was the feedback only visual? | Did audio help entrainment?
Q_ZH: 呼啸声在实验中起什么作用？ | 反馈仅仅是视觉的吗？ | 声音有助于节律同步吗？
A_EN: The whoosh sound marked the start of a Stroke. It reinforced the visual phase boundary. We treated it as part of the multimodal feedback. But we did not test audio alone. So we cannot separate its effect.
A_ZH: 呼啸声标记发力的开始。它强化视觉阶段边界。我们把它当作多模态反馈的一部分。但我们没有单独测试音频。所以我们无法分离它的效果。
Followup_Q_EN: So can you claim audio caused entrainment? | Did you test without audio? | Is whoosh essential?
Followup_Q_ZH: 所以你能声称音频导致节律同步吗？ | 你没音频测试过吗？ | 呼啸声是必要的吗？
Followup_A_EN: No. We cannot separate the audio contribution from the visual one. | No. All participants experienced the same multimodal presentation. | We do not know. It reinforced the phase boundary, but we cannot say whether it was essential.
Followup_A_ZH: 不能。我们无法把音频贡献与视觉贡献分离。 | 没有。所有参与者经历相同的多模态呈现。 | 我们不知道。它强化了阶段边界，但我们不能说它是否必要。

Q_EN: Can this be deployed in commercial gyms tomorrow? | Does it require specialized rowing machines? | What is the barrier to productization?
Q_ZH: 这个明天就能部署到商业健身房吗？ | 它需要专用划船机吗？ | 产品化的障碍是什么？
A_EN: The prototype can be retrofitted to existing equipment. If the sensor fits. But commercial deployment needs more work. We need broader segmentation. For irregular and compound moves. And more systematic validation.
A_ZH: 原型可以加装到现有设备上。如果传感器能装。但商业部署需要更多工作。我们需要更广的分割。针对不规则和复合动作。以及更系统的验证。
Followup_Q_EN: Could you deploy it tomorrow? | What is the main blocker? | Is this close to product?
Followup_Q_ZH: 明天能部署吗？ | 主要障碍是什么？ | 这接近产品了吗？
Followup_A_EN: Not as a validated commercial system. The current work is a research prototype. | Segmentation of irregular and compound movements. Our pipeline targets repetitive rhythmic motion. | Some pieces are close, like the low-cost hardware. Others need more validation.
Followup_A_ZH: 不能作为经过验证的商业系统。当前工作是研究原型。 | 不规则和复合运动的分割。我们的管线针对重复性节奏运动。 | 有些部分接近了，比如低成本硬件。其他需要更多验证。

Q_EN: I loved your opening story. Did your wife actually buy into the scientific equipment argument? | Why did you really start this project? | Is the clothes rack safe now?
Q_ZH: 我很喜欢你的开场故事。你妻子真的相信这是科研设备了吗？ | 你到底为什么开始这个项目？ | 晾衣架现在安全了吗？
A_EN: Getting into VINCI helped my case. But seriously, it started from a real question. Why does home fitness gear feel so disconnected? That question became the start of this framework.
A_ZH: 能被 VINCI 录用帮了大忙。但认真地说，它始于一个真实问题。为什么家用健身设备感觉如此脱节？这个问题成为这个框架的起点。
Followup_Q_EN: Is it still a clothes rack? | Did your wife approve? | What did your daughter think?
Followup_Q_ZH: 它还是晾衣架吗？ | 你妻子同意了吗？ | 你女儿怎么看？
Followup_A_EN: Fortunately, it has survived the research process. It is now a legitimate piece of research equipment. | Getting accepted to VINCI helped my case. She is now more supportive than before. | She helped with data collection and inspired the original idea. She is part of the project.
Followup_A_ZH: 幸运的是，它在研究过程中幸存了下来。它现在是一件合法研究设备。 | 能被 VINCI 录用帮了大忙。她现在比以前更支持了。 | 她帮助数据收集并启发了最初想法。她是项目的一部分。

Q_EN: Have you considered using advanced non-linear modeling like LSTMs? | What about deploying sensor fusion algorithms? | Why not use frequency-domain analysis?
Q_ZH: 你考虑过使用像 LSTM 这样的高级非线性建模吗？ | 部署传感器融合算法怎么样？ | 为什么不用频域分析？
A_EN: We kept the pipeline light on purpose. This is an exploratory short paper. More advanced methods are future work. Nonlinear models. Sensor fusion. Those fit a larger study.
A_ZH: 我们有意保持流程轻量。这是探索性短文。更先进的方法是未来工作。非线性模型。传感器融合。那些适合更大研究。
Followup_Q_EN: Why not use AI? | Why not LSTMs? | Isn't lightweight a limitation?
Followup_Q_ZH: 为什么不用 AI？ | 为什么不用 LSTM？ | 轻量不是局限吗？
Followup_A_EN: Because the research question is about semantic abstraction, not signal-model complexity. | LSTMs are a potential future direction. For an exploratory short paper, we kept the pipeline lightweight. | It is a limitation for signal quality, but not for the semantic contribution.
Followup_A_ZH: 因为研究问题是关于语义抽象的，不是信号模型复杂度。 | LSTM 是潜在未来方向。对探索性短文，我们保持管线轻量。 | 对信号质量是局限，但对语义贡献不是。

Q_EN: Did you use AI in this research? | How did you use AI? | How much of the system was designed by you versus assisted by AI?
Q_ZH: 你在这项研究中用了 AI 吗？ | 你怎么用的 AI？ | 系统有多少是你设计的，多少是 AI 辅助的？
A_EN: Yes. We used AI as a coding and writing assistant. Debugging. Language editing. But the research question is ours. The protocol is ours. The semantic model is ours. The final interpretations are ours. AI code was checked and run by us.
A_ZH: 是的。我们把 AI 用作编码和写作助手。调试。语言编辑。但研究问题是我们的。方案是我们的。语义模型是我们的。最终解释是我们的。AI 代码由我们检查和运行。
Followup_Q_EN: Did AI write your statistical analysis? | So which parts are actually yours? | Can you show the code?
Followup_Q_ZH: AI 写了统计分析吗？ | 哪些部分真的是你的？ | 能展示代码吗？
Followup_A_EN: AI-assisted coding was part of the workflow.
